title: Printable assessment for automated tests
comment: A few questions with the controls the printing tests check. exam23-printing covers every question type for manual testing.
text:
Answer every question in the space provided. Show your work, since partial credit depends on it.

Write clearly; answers that cannot be read will not receive credit.

Calculators are allowed, but phones and notes must stay in your bag for the whole exam.

If a question seems ambiguous, state your assumptions and answer the question as you understand it.

Raise your hand if you need more paper. Do not detach any pages from this booklet.

When you finish, check that your name appears on every page before handing in your exam.
